INSERT INTO sondages (
            id, code, geom, depth_m_min, depth_m_max, comment, source
        )
        VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint($3, $4), $5), 25231),
            $6,
            $7,
            $8,
            'UI-v1.1'
        )
        RETURNING 
            code,
            ST_X(ST_Transform(geom, 4326)) as lon,
            ST_Y(ST_Transform(geom, 4326)) as lat,
            maille_code,
            adm1_name,
            adm2_name,
            adm3_name,
            created_at
